svg.aria-label: hermes-max-messenger architecture: MAX app, MAX Bot API, transport, inbound, Hermes Agent, speech-to-text, outbound, rate limiter
svg.text: ① A message arrives — long poll or webhook, its place saved first
② A voice note goes to the speech-to-text provider you chose
③ While Hermes thinks, MAX shows “typing…”
④ The answer streams back as edits, paced by the limiter
